title: Furan Acids from Nutmeg and Their Neuroprotective and Anti-neuroinflammatory Activities.
authors: Le, Tam Thi; Tran, Son Hung; Lee, Sohyun; Kang, Suk Woo; Kim, Ji Hoon; Park, Keunwan; Kim, Chung Sub; Kim, Myungsuk; Kang, Kyungsu; Jung, Sang Hoon
journal: Journal of agricultural and food chemistry
one_liner_zh: 该文从肉豆蔻中分离呋喃酸等化合物，研究其神经保护与抗炎活性，虽含分子对接但对象为小分子-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: Nutmeg (Myristica fragrans) has been traditionally valued for its culinary and medicinal properties. In our ongoing efforts to discover pharmacologically active compounds from this spice, five new furan acids (2-6, jusahos B-F), one new neolignan (7, jusaho G), and six known compounds (1 and 8-12) were isolated from its nutmegs. The chemical structures of the compounds were elucidated using NMR spectroscopy and HRESIMS. Among them, compound 3 (jusaho C) demonstrated promising antineuroinflammatory and neuroprotective effects in BV2 and HT22 cells by modulating the MAPK/NF-kappaB signaling pathway, which was explored through network pharmacology, molecular docking, and experimental verification. Compound 3 also showed the improvement of locomotor activity in Caenorhabditis elegans model infected with Pseudomonas aeruginosa. These findings expand the phytochemical profile of M. fragrans, where only one furan acid was previously reported, and highlight nutmeg-derived compounds, particularly jusaho C, as potential functional food ingredients or nutraceuticals for managing neuroinflammatory conditions.
abstract_zh: 肉豆蔻（*Myristica fragrans*）因其烹饪和药用价值而历来受到重视。在我们持续从该香料中寻找药理活性化合物的过程中，从其肉豆蔻中分离出五个新的呋喃酸类化合物（2-6，jusahos B-F）、一个新木脂素类化合物（7，jusaho G）以及六个已知化合物（1和8-12）。通过核磁共振波谱（NMR spectroscopy）和高分辨电喷雾电离质谱（HRESIMS）阐明了这些化合物的化学结构。其中，化合物3（jusaho C）通过调节MAPK/NF-kappaB信号通路，在BV2和HT22细胞中显示出有前景的抗神经炎症和神经保护作用，这一作用通过网络药理学、分子对接和实验验证进行了探索。化合物3还改善了感染铜绿假单胞菌的秀丽隐杆线虫模型中的运动活性。这些发现扩展了*M. fragrans*的植物化学特征，此前仅报道过一种呋喃酸，并突显了源自肉豆蔻的化合物，特别是jusaho C，作为管理神经炎症状况的潜在功能性食品成分或营养保健品。
